dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, how many carrots do we need?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈkærəts duː wiː ˈniːd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Two. And we need one cabbage, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː. ənd wiː ˈniːd ˈwʌn ˈkæbɪdʒ, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: About ten. And how much rice do you have at home?
dialogue.reading: əˈbaʊt ˈtɛn. ənd ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈraɪs duː juː ˈhæv ət ˈhoʊm?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A lot! I have a big bag.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɑːt! aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈbɪɡ ˈbæɡ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good. Excuse me, how much are these cucumbers?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ɪkˈskjuːz miː, ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ər ðiːz ˈkjuːkʌmbərz?
